title: "Bringing a workflow in"
description: "Import an existing workflow into Cascade, what maps across and what the importer tells you it could not carry."
editUrl: false
---

`hotloop-cascade workflows convert export.json -o workflow.yaml --report report.json`
converts a workflow exported as JSON from another tool. It carries across what
it can be sure of: the steps it knows and the field reads in their settings.
Everything else comes across switched off, with its original settings in its
notes, and the report lists each one and why. It never turns a JavaScript
expression into a guess about what it meant, and it never brings credentials,
because an export doesn't have them: the report says which slot needs which.
Then `workflows import workflow.yaml` puts it in.
